name: Big Hands
body:
Prerequisite: Taddol, Str 15.

Benefit: You can wield a one-handed melee weapon as though it was a light weapons. Light weapons, two-handed weapons, and oversized weapons are not affected by this feat.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
